capability.summary: Multimodal model for reasoning over supplied documents and media.
capability.problem_space: Multimodal model for reasoning over supplied documents and media. Applicable tasks include document question answering, audio understanding, video understanding, visual reasoning, code generation. Accepts text, image, audio, video, pdf input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions.

env_requirements: Endpoint exposing the documented model through Chat Completions; gateway mapping unverified
Valid API key for the selected service or an explicitly configured self-hosted endpoint
Endpoint and transport support for every requested input and output modality
Native media types and provider-hosted tools require corresponding gateway and framework adapters.
The minimal thinking level is not supported.
constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text, image, audio, video, pdf | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.
